fields.title: EU launches coastal restoration call for regional pilot teams
fields.field_teaser: Regional teams can now apply for a new EU-backed coastal restoration call focused on measurable pilot actions and reusable data.

body.value:
The European Commission has opened a new call for regional pilot teams working on coastal restoration and shoreline resilience.

The programme will support small-scale actions that combine community participation, practical restoration work, and evidence gathering for future policy decisions.

Selected projects will publish their methods and findings in a reusable format so local administrations and partner organisations can compare outcomes across different coastal contexts.

fields.title: Member states invited to test shoreline resilience measures in new EU pilot round
fields.field_teaser: A second fixture variant reframes the story around shoreline resilience pilots, updated messaging, and coordinated reporting before autumn.

body.value:
The European Commission has refreshed the coastal restoration announcement with a stronger focus on shoreline resilience measures and operational reporting.

Under the updated framing, participating teams will test practical interventions, document implementation constraints, and share evidence with a common editorial structure.

The revised draft highlights coordinated reporting milestones so editors can compare pilot outcomes before the next policy review window.
